# Settable theme variables

These 49 Nextcloud theme variables have a token without a default. Declare the token in a token set, or set the variable in the token editor, and the page takes your value. Leave it out and Nextcloud keeps its own value for light, dark and high contrast.

A value in the set's light file applies to light only. Give a dark value in the set's dark file (`css/tokens/dark/{set}.css`). Variables marked advanced change Nextcloud's layout: test every app after setting one.

Two pairs are checked by the contrast audit when a set declares either side:

- selected text (`--nldesign-color-text-selection`) on the selection background (`--nldesign-color-background-selection`)
- body text (`--nldesign-color-text`) on the search highlight (`--nldesign-color-mark`)

| Variable | Token | Light | Dark | Advanced | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--background-invert-if-bright` | `--nldesign-background-invert-if-bright` | invert(100%) | no |  | Nextcloud inverts dark icons with this filter when the background is bright. It switches per theme; set it only to change that behaviour. |
| `--background-invert-if-dark` | `--nldesign-background-invert-if-dark` | no | invert(100%) |  | Nextcloud inverts dark icons with this filter when the background is dark. It switches per theme; set it only to change that behaviour. |
| `--body-container-margin` | `--nldesign-body-container-margin` | calc(var(--default-grid-baseline) * 2) | calc(var(--default-grid-baseline) * 2) | yes | The gap around the app container. Nextcloud derives it from the grid baseline. |
| `--body-container-radius` | `--nldesign-body-container-radius` | var(--border-radius-container-large) | var(--border-radius-container-large) |  | A container radius, not a control radius: #content draws its corners from it. Nextcloud keeps 0 and rounds the top corners from --border-radius-large. |
| `--body-height` | `--nldesign-body-height` | calc(100% - env(safe-area-inset-bottom) - var(--header-height) - var(--body-container-margin)) | calc(100% - env(safe-area-inset-bottom) - var(--header-height) - var(--body-container-margin)) | yes | Nextcloud calculates it from the header height and the safe area. A wrong value cuts off the bottom of every app. |
| `--border-radius-container` | `--nldesign-border-radius-container` | 12px | 12px |  | Radius of containers such as cards and dialogs (12px in Nextcloud). Controls take --border-radius-element. |
| `--border-radius-container-large` | `--nldesign-border-radius-container-large` | 16px | 16px |  | Radius of large containers (16px in Nextcloud). The top corners of the app container follow it. |
| `--border-width-input` | `--nldesign-border-width-input` | 1px | 1px |  | Border width of text inputs (1px in Nextcloud). |
| `--border-width-input-focused` | `--nldesign-border-width-input-focused` | 2px | 2px |  | Border width of a focused text input (2px in Nextcloud). |
| `--breakpoint-mobile` | `--nldesign-breakpoint-mobile` | 1024px | 1024px | yes | Width below which Nextcloud switches to its mobile layout (1024px). Nextcloud reads it in JavaScript too. |
| `--clickable-area-large` | `--nldesign-clickable-area-large` | 48px | 48px | yes | Large touch target (48px in Nextcloud). WCAG 2.5.8 asks for at least 24px. |
| `--clickable-area-small` | `--nldesign-clickable-area-small` | 24px | 24px | yes | Small touch target (24px in Nextcloud). WCAG 2.5.8 asks for at least 24px. |

| `--color-background-selection` | `--nldesign-color-background-selection` | rgb(from var(--color-primary-element) r g b / 0.2) | rgb(from var(--color-primary-element) r g b / 0.4) |  | Nextcloud tints it from the primary colour at 20% opacity, so selected text stays legible. The contrast audit checks it against the selected text. |
